facts.big: She said she was online all night
facts.label: said + past progressive
facts.sub: Para contar o que alguém disse, volte um tempo: He said he was studying. She told me that she was waiting. Said não leva pessoa; told leva.

facts.label: disse que…
facts.sub: Quando contar o que alguém falou, volte um tempo: “I am studying” vira He said he was studying. Said não precisa de pessoa, mas pode usar said to me.

facts.label: me contou que…
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa + that: He told me that he was playing games. Não diga He told that nem He said me. That pode ser omitido na conversa.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele disse que estava estudando” e usamos o mesmo tempo.
compare.us: Em inglês, também: He said he was studying. A diferença é said (sem pessoa) e told (com pessoa): He told me that…

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: He said he was studying.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Said he was studying reports “I am studying”.

items.why: We say He told me that… or He said that…

items.s: Told needs a person after it.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Said he was studying reports “I am studying”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He said me that…”. → Falso (We say He told me that… or He said that…)
Told needs a person after it. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A living room in Portland · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet evening in Portland. Eva and Gina sit on a sofa. They are talking about their friend Sam. Sam said strange things last week. Gina is not sure he told the truth. Eva has a funny idea.

“Eva, Sam said he was studying all night. Do you believe him?” says Gina. “No. He said he was working on his project, but he was on his phone.” says Eva. “Really? How do you know? Did he tell you that?” says Gina.
